title: Coordinates Convention (coords:)
description: Schema for coords information in Zarr. Properties use the 'coords:' namespace prefix.

attributes.description: Zarr attributes containing convention metadata and coords: prefixed properties

conventionMetadata.description: Coordinates convention metadata object for use in zarr_conventions array

schema_url.description: URL to the JSON Schema definition for this convention

spec_url.description: URL to the full specification document

uuid.description: UUID that permanently identifies this convention

description.const: Generic mapping between Zarr array index space and coordinate space — declares dimensions, locates coordinate descriptors, and composes with the spatial convention for affine transforms or CF-style explicit arrays for non-spatial dimensions.
description.description: Brief description of the convention's purpose and usage

coordsAttributes.description: Coordinates properties using coords: key prefix

coords:coordinates.description: Map from dimension name (or comma-joined tuple of dimension names for multi-dimensional coordinates such as 'y,x') to a coordinate descriptor. Dimension names are NOT redeclared here — they are taken from the Zarr v3 'dimension_names' field of the same array (or the Zarr v2 / Xarray '_ARRAY_DIMENSIONS' attribute).

oneOf.description: Explicit coordinate array. Points to a sibling Zarr array via a Zarr-relative path. Coordinate semantics (e.g. CF standard_name, units, axis) are not defined by this convention and MAY appear as additional properties; a future 'cf:' convention may formalize them.

path.description: Zarr-relative path to the coordinate array.

oneOf.description: Affine spatial coordinate, delegating to the spatial convention's transform on the same node or an ancestor group.

convention.description: Name of the sibling convention providing the affine transform (defaults to 'spatial').

oneOf.description: Reference to another named convention (temporal, vertical, spectral, lookup, or future domain-specific) that defines this coordinate's semantics.

convention.description: Name of the sibling convention that defines this coordinate.

oneOf.description: Inline coordinate values, embedded directly. Intended for short auxiliary axes (e.g. a small band/spectral axis) where allocating a separate Zarr array would be wasteful.

coords:version.description: Major version of the coords convention this metadata was authored against.
